text:
zoe: Heads-up from int8 onboarding for pelagia-v2: consistent quality hit on mixed-script samples (CJK + RTL) after quant rollout. small repro below.
hiro: Paste the string + FP16 vs INT8 tokenization/detok pls.
zoe: here you go:
```
Source: 


北京·المدين・—-
FP16 detok: 
北京·المدين・—
INT8 detok: 北京・المدين-・
```
(Notice em-dash vs hyphen, middle dot vs katakana dot, stray control bytes).
pavan: Token dumps from our harness show a seam shift pre-model for INT8: FP16 tokens = ["\u5317","\u4eac","\u00b7","\u0627...","\u2014","\u30fb"] INT8 tokens = ["\u5317","\u4eac","\u30fb","\u0627...","-","\u30fb"]
mira: CI smoke: pelagia-v2-int8 4949007799: chrf_base=0.661, chrf_int8=0.619, regressions=389, top-pattern="mixedpunct-seam"
hiro: Two likely vectors: (A) tokeniser normalizer differences between artifact builds (we trimmed vocab for int8), (B) runtime quant kernel packing path that affects early byte handling in the tokenizer binary. first check canonicalization.
zoe: Quick mitigation: ingress normalizer to NFKC + explicit mapping table for punct+ZW chars. prototype: s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', s); s = s.replace('\u00B7','\u30FB'); s = s.replace('\u2014','-'); s = re.sub('[\x00-\x1F]','', s)
hiro: don't drop controls silently; replace with U+FFFD and emit metric. add feature flag tokenize.canonicalize_unicode for canary.
pavan: Also add unit test fixtures with blended scripts and assert tokens identical for canonicalized inputs across FP16/INT8: tests/locale/multiscript_punct.txt
ci-bot: canary-plan pelagia-int8-canon 4949007805: route 4% int8 traffic, collect BLEU/chrF + token-dump traces.
zoe: owners: zoe normalizer PR, pavan tests, hiro canary. If canonicalization recovers >90% we'll ship; otherwise escalate to tokenizer artifact serialization audit. Thanks, keep updates here. :mag_right:
